scientific_question: How to address measured undercoverage without mistaking numerical correctness or interval calibration for an improved probability generator or improved adaptive query policy?
scope: Three selected primary method papers. This is a bounded selected-section review, not an exhaustive novelty search and not full reading of all papers.
queries: active learning model misspecification uncertainty sampling failures regression calibration primary paper
Conformal prediction under feedback covariate shift biomolecular design Fannjiang 2022 PNAS
Evaluating Predictive Uncertainty Under Dataset Shift Ovadia 2019 NeurIPS official

sources.title: Active Learning for Misspecified Models
sources.version: Official published conference PDF; no upstream code commit used
sources.license: Exact redistribution license not independently verified; no PDF/source redistributed
sources.actual_read_depth: Introduction and selected sections 2-4, pages 1-5, assumptions/formula discussion and selected toy interpretation; not every experiment or proof. The conference text points proofs to an extended version.
sources.finding_zh: 模型失配时，改变采样输入分布可引入偏差；仅降低模型方差不足。文中重要性加权与渐近条件不能直接变成当前有限样本原生单位CRPS证书。
sources.application_limit_zh: 本文不是对任意主动学习、任意未知采样密度或当前NIW算法的校准保证。

sources.finding_zh: 反馈协变量转移可处理训练数据影响设计分布，但要求不变的条件响应、所需密度比及绝对连续等条件；输出是预测集合覆盖，不是生成概率密度。
sources.application_limit_zh: 当前risk-field使用目标上下文参与选点，不能仅将材料分组后套普通split conformal。后续独立校准/审计上下文不得参与模型或动作选择；转移权重未知时不宣称转移覆盖。

sources.title: When Active Learning Fails, Uncalibrated Out of Distribution Uncertainty Quantification Might Be the Problem
sources.venue: arXiv preprint; acceptance elsewhere not verified
sources.license: Full HTML identifies CC BY 4.0; no source/article redistributed
sources.actual_read_depth: Abstract; selected introduction, ID/OOD data split and evaluation, calibration/results/discussion and Data/Code Availability. Did not audit all supplementary experiments or reproduce results.
sources.code_availability_qualified: v1 says code will be released on GitHub upon acceptance; present-day repository/release status not independently checked, so no claim that code currently does not exist.
sources.finding_zh: 直接涉及JARVIS等材料的主动学习；ID残差校准未必改善OOD与选点效用。统一线性缩放不改变不确定性排序。区间可靠性、排序质量和数据效率应分别评估。
sources.application_limit_zh: 论文用JARVIS-22，当前用冻结2018发布源，不是同一快照直接复现；本项目不能宣称首次发现材料主动学习欠校准或首次校准材料主动学习。

decision: Keep current NIG active experiment frozen; propose one separately costed prospective interval diagnostic, with new unused same-source groups and explicit exchangeability scope. Do not present the conformal layer as a generative distribution or as a novel mechanism.
